summary: Phase 5 (Investment Grade v2 - clickable checklist with uploads) fully validated. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering POST /api/upload with doc_type Form field, GET /api/documents (auth-gated, excludes soft-deleted), DELETE /api/documents/{id} (soft delete removes item from list AND flips checklist done back to false), /investment-grade checklist wires upload_type only on 3 doc items (financials/assets/contracts) and correctly excludes EBITDA + dependency items, confidence.score rises when docs are uploaded (0% -> higher), tier upgrades (Estimativa Inteligente -> Fundamentada -> Nível Profissional) and value_range narrows (35% -> 20% -> 10% margin). Frontend: end-to-end at /relatorio for premium admin. checklist-0..4 rendered; upload-financials/upload-assets/upload-contracts buttons present on the 3 document-backed items, and NOT rendered on items 1 (EBITDA) and 4 (dependency). Clicking Carregar opens file picker via doc-file-input; after upload, page reloads report, checklist-0 flips to green check (CheckCircle2 / #10B981), upload-financials button disappears, confidence banner updates from '0% dos dados formais' to '20% dos dados formais'. Toast 'Documento carregado — avaliação atualizada.' shown. Admin's Stripe/premium state untouched; all test documents were soft-deleted via DELETE /api/documents/{id} at end of run (0 docs remaining, admin report back to clean 0% baseline).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/upload accepts doc_type: str = Form('other') - default 'other' is sensible; validated in test_upload_default_doc_type_is_other. No server-side allowlist for doc_type values (financials|assets|contracts|other) - any string is accepted and stored. Non-breaking since checklist only checks membership of the three known types, but consider validating to avoid pollution of the documents collection with typos.

GET /api/documents excludes _id properly (returns id as str). DELETE uses ObjectId(doc_id) but does not verify the ObjectId is valid - a malformed id would raise bson.errors.InvalidId (500) rather than 404. Minor; not blocking.

Investment-grade checklist item 'Contratos e qualidade da carteira de clientes' has done=True if EITHER a 'contracts' doc exists OR company.clients_count>0. This dual-source logic is documented via the checklist item alone and is intentional (contracts OR client base), verified functionally.

InvestmentGrade.jsx load() is now a reusable useCallback - onFile reloads the report inline. Good pattern. The upload flow uses a single hidden <input type=file> with a ref + pendingType ref to route the file to the right doc_type - clean, no per-item duplication.

After upload, frontend calls /api/upload then /api/investment-grade in sequence; total UX latency ~6-10s due to LLM call inside grade endpoint. Toast fires on success; button becomes CheckCircle2 (green) and its testid is unmounted (verified via wait_for_selector state='detached').
server.py still ~1068 lines - modularization (auth / payments / ai / uploads) remains desirable but not urgent.
